description: This file is an Android Java source file defining the RunningProcesses activity, which displays a list of currently running app processes using Android's ActivityManager and ListView. It includes inner classes for list adapter and list items, handles Activity lifecycle, and navigates to a ProcessInfo activity on item click.

classes.name: RunningProcesses
classes.description: Main activity class that displays and manages the list of running app processes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the adapter, and manages the activity lifecycle.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles list item clicks, starting ProcessInfo activity with process details.
